results.note: Boundary flip: equal keys report 'behind' instead of 'ahead', prescribing the wrong remedy.
or/and swap: one unrankable side falls through to comparing None against a tuple instead of reporting 'unordered'.
Swapped arguments: drift direction inverts, so 'behind'/'ahead' and their remedies are reported backwards.
None-vs-truthiness: an empty-string version reads as 'absent' rather than being compared.
Dropped normalization guard: empty string no longer short-circuits, changing the unordered/ranked boundary for blank versions.
and/or swap in the registry record filter: non-dict entries reach record.get() and raise.
Removed the cache fallback: a missing/unreadable registry returns None instead of scanning the cache.
Comparison flip in the cache scan: picks the LOWEST cached version instead of the highest.
Setup checklist stops flagging the 'ahead' case; renders a DONE row as if the halves matched.
Boolean flip in csb status: every drifted pair reports green 'matches CLI'.
Changed exit code: the refused 'plugin already ahead' path reports success, hiding the no-op from scripts.
Comparison flip after the update runs: a no-change update announces 'Updated: X -> X'.
